title: Operation Moonwatch and its 36 UFO reports

tellings.quote: so Alan Heinek was helping Whipple in this program and they actually had 36 UFO report that I think Jacquali found that we now uh like also look through.

plain: Operation Moonwatch was a 1950s sky-watching programme run from Harvard by the astronomer Fred Whipple, with about a dozen tracking stations around the world, and according to the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel it logged 36 UFO reports. She says J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer who later advised the Air Force on UFOs, helped Whipple run it, and that the researcher Jacques Vallée found those reports, which her own team is now going through. She tells it as background to her research, and it would mean trained observers in a scientific programme recorded unexplained sightings.
